theorem continuousAt_round [IsStrictOrderedRing α] [OrderClosedTopology α] [ContinuousAdd α]
    {x : α} (hx : 2 * fract x ≠ 1) : ContinuousAt round x := by
  rw [ContinuousAt, ← nhdsLT_sup_nhdsGE, tendsto_sup]
  refine ⟨?_, (tendsto_round_nhdsGE_pure x).mono_right (pure_le_nhds _)⟩
  rw [round_eq_half_ceil_two_mul hx]
  exact (tendsto_round_nhdsLT_pure_half_ceil x).mono_right (pure_le_nhds _)
